summary: Illinois Tool Works Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a $1.5 billion offering of 4.650% senior unsecured notes due 2029, priced at 99.748% of par with a 0.250% underwriting discount, yielding proceeds before expenses of $1,492.47 million. The notes mature August 13, 2029, pay semi-annual interest, are redeemable at ITW's option, and will be issued in book-entry form through DTC, Clearstream, and Euroclear. Citigroup, J.P. Morgan, BofA Securities, and Goldman Sachs acted as joint book-running managers. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation; no deal terms apply.
